Elaine: Heads up — after last night's late ingest replay we saw a spike in console aggregate counts and a huge billing bump. Can we triage pacing + dashboard artifacts?
Tariq: Job id? dataset + approx rows?
Elaine: job=backfill-2026-03-18-0312, dataset=telemetry.v2_events, ~120M rows replayed, cloud cost estimate ~ $2.3k extra for the run. Dashboard show total_requests up ~3x for the window.
Jonas: Yikes. Did the replay tag events so we can exclude them from production aggregates?
Maya: I don't think the tag was attached until mid-run — we have gaps. Console aggregates are doing raw counts so they included backfilled events.
Kevin: Console panel doesn't currently have a "exclude backfill" toggle. Quick workaround: update the saved query with `WHERE backfill_tag IS NULL OR backfill_tag = FALSE` for the aggregate panels. I'll patch one dashboard for the incident.
Tariq: Meanwhile we should immediately throttle the backfill. backfill-coordinator supports `--concurrency` and `--rate-limit` params. Infra run: `backfill-coordinator scale backfill-2026-03-18-0312 --concurrency 5 --rate-limit 200/s`
InfraBot: Started scale operation for backfill-2026-03-18-0312: concurrency 20 -> 5.
Jonas: Long-term we should pace replays by ingest delta vs baseline so we don't swamp the collector or skew metrics. Idea: compute per-shard safe_rate = baseline_ingest * 1.2 and cap replay to that.
Maya: Also need to ensure downstream aggregations are idempotent or can be re-run safely. Do we have dedupe keys for this dataset?
Elaine: Yes, events have (user_id, event_id) dedupe key. Replay process will de-dup, but intermediate aggregates didn't respect the flag so counts doubled.
Jonas: Pseudo: `for shard in shards: safe_rps = max(baseline_rps[shard]*1.2, min_rate); schedule_replay(shard, rps=safe_rps, window=1h)` — also add exponential backoff if collector backpressure metrics spike.
Kevin: UX follow-up: I'll add a small console toggle (hide backfill) and short helper text. Won't be ready in <24h but I can ship a quick patch to one critical panel.
Tariq: For the immediate backfill, can we run a canary: 3 tenants at concurrency 2 for 30m, check latency, error-rate, and per-tenant cost?
Maya: +1. Also add a telemetry tag `replay_plan=canary-0319` and a boolean `backfill=true` to all events from this job so we can filter reliably.
Elaine: I'll coordinate canary now. Running: `backfill-coordinator run backfill-2026-03-18-0312 --tenants tenantA,tenantB,tenantC --concurrency 2 --tag replay_plan=canary-0319 --tag backfill=true`
InfraBot: backfill-2026-03-18-0312: staged canary run started — tenants=3, concurrency=2, rate_limit=100/s
Jonas: Add monitoring dash: latency p50/p95, ingestion queue depth, downstream aggregate freshness. If any of those exceed thresholds, auto-pause the job.
Maya: Action items: 1) Elaine: run canary (now). 2) Kevin: patch one dashboard to exclude backfill. 3) Jonas & Tariq: add pacing heuristic to backfill-coordinator. 4) Infra team: add auto-pause on collector backpressure. I'll own verifying aggregated counts after canary.
Elaine: Oncall @sre on deck to watch alerts for the next 2h. Starting canary now.
Kevin: will follow up here once dashboard patch is deployed.
Elaine: Can everyone ack here when you see the canary metrics? :eyes:
Tariq: Ack, monitoring.
Jonas: Ack.
Maya: Ack.
Kevin: Ack, patch queued. :thumbsup:
InfraBot: backfill-2026-03-18-0312-canary: metrics stream active (p50=18ms p95=62ms), ingest_queue=12% capacity, cost_rate=$45/hr (est).
